title: Consent Record
description: Per-channel consent state machine. NO outbound call or SMS may fire unless the matching channel is granted=true AND revoked_at is null AND proof exists. Email cold outreach is permitted under CAN-SPAM without prior consent but MUST honor suppression.

artifact_url.description: Form event id, email message id, or recording ref

form_copy_version.description: The exact disclosure text version shown at opt-in

revoked_at.description: Set on STOP reply, unsubscribe, or verbal revocation. Irreversible without a NEW opt-in event.

suppressed.description: On any revocation or bounce-hard, suppress across the channel permanently.
